name: Collab Notes
author: Paolo Sartorio

sections.description:
Collab Notes is a simple and effective plugin to manage private notes for pages and posts directly in the WordPress admin area.

Key Features:
– Add private notes to any page or post.
– Notes are visible only in the WordPress admin area.
– Customize which user roles can add, edit, or view notes.
– An icon is displayed in the post/page list for content with notes, making it easy to identify.
– Lightweight and easy to use, with no impact on site performance.

This plugin is perfect for teams and administrators who want to keep internal notes, reminders, or task lists linked to specific content.

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin as a .zip file or install directly from the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Upload the collab-notes folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin in the WordPress admin under Plugins > Installed Plugins.
  4. (Optional) Configure user roles permissions under Settings > Collab Notes.
sections.faq:
Who can see the notes?

By default, only administrators can see and add notes. However, you can configure user role permissions in the settings page.

Can I add notes to custom post types?

Currently, notes are supported only for Pages and Posts. Support for custom post types may be added in a future update.

Do the notes appear on the front end of the site?

No, the notes are strictly for internal use in the WordPress admin area.

Is this plugin compatible with all themes?

Yes, the plugin is designed to work with any WordPress theme since it only modifies the admin area.
